title: Concept: Gemfile.lock carries a private namespace gem
description: Gemfile.lock declares a locked spec whose name sits in the private `acme-` namespace, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A private name resolved from the public source is the dependency-confusion path: whoever publishes that name first wins the install.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Gemfile.lock (rubygems).
risk: A private name resolved from the public source is the dependency-confusion path: whoever publishes that name first wins the install.
